handoff.salientSummary: Fixed the foh-core App defects: setup deletes and pacing channel, special-days block, conflicts panel mapping, Book/Today/detail filters, counters and history, floor seating, timeline notices, full Lingui/Arabic sweep, floor-plan save semantics. Verified in the running App (English, Arabic, KSA smoke). Typecheck clean, ESLint 0 errors, 113 reservations tests pass, check-lingui passes. Committed as 4e0149b1.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Setup: pacing channel type/select narrowed to all/online; Delete calls for pacing and service-availability now resolve through the backend's new location-scoped routes. /conflicts items are normalized (normalizeSetupConflict) to code, date, party size and localized reason; fetchSetupConflicts enriches code and party size from booking details using a book-scoped client (settings.tsx). Special-days block displays its stored window in the location time zone. Book/Today/detail sheet: service/area/source/tag filters go to the day query via URL params in use-host-stand; parties/covers counters; Source and Tag selects; detail sheet shows source, occasion, dining area, table, dietary and notes plus a timestamped change history loaded from GET /book/reservations/:id/events; phone booking sheet has a free-text dietary notes field sent as dietaryNotes. Floor: seating by drag sends tableIds and refreshes from the response so the table shows occupied. Timeline: ConflictPanel shows reflow move notices and displaced locked bookings (blocked table/overlap) with localized reasons, and bar aria-labels are translated. i18n: new utils/reservations/labels.ts maps status, course, contact, channel, VIP, tag, occasion, dietary, live table status, conflict reason, move-notice reason, event type, actor kind and element kind to Lingui descriptors; wired through Book, Today, detail sheet, floor, calendar, overview, walk-in dialog, booking sheet, settings pages, and section default names. Arabic ar.po filled for all new messages. Floor-plan handleSave treats a 200 PUT as success, takes floorPlanVersion from the PUT response and reports a failed refetch separately. Stale 30 s comments and the use-live-now default changed to 15 s.
